summary: Evolve BuilderOS into a self-improving decision-quality system by locking the six design principles and the Mission 2 success test into canonical SSOT, creating a minimal artifact-based Collaboration Spine, mechanically enforcing blueprint authority, converging runtime schedulers, closing the SMOS revenue loop, and making Wisdom decision-aware.

blocking_reasons: Await comparison with ChatGPT and CloudCode blueprints; merge into a single approved mission plan before execution.

post_completion_followups: Update docs/products/builderos/PRODUCT_HOME.md and docs/CONTINUITY_LOG.md with final Mission 2 Convergence receipts.
Add FACTORY-BUILDEROS-CONVERGENCE-0001 to builderos-reboot/BP_PRIORITY.json as a completed item or supersede with the next ranked mission.
Write the Mission 3 scoping note: what is now cheaper/faster because of this mission.

coder_must_not_decide: what counts as proof if the blueprint did not define it
whether a semantic answer is good enough when acceptance is soft
whether stale authority can be reused
whether a lesson discovered by ARC or Sentry can remain unpromoted
whether a design principle can be weakened for convenience

non_goals: Do not build a real-time AI chat room.
Do not create a second active queue.
Do not redesign the Chair from scratch; preserve the SO-003 regression test.
Do not migrate email providers unless the chosen provider is configured and verified.
Do not manually patch around BuilderOS.
Do not produce another comprehensive audit; build only what enforces and verifies convergence.
Do not optimize for passing Mission 2; optimize for making Mission 3 easier.

phases.title: Final convergence, handoff, and Mission 3 prep

steps.title: Lock the BuilderOS Convergence design principles into SSOT authority
required_edits: Create docs/constitution/AMENDMENT_BUILDEROS_CONVERGENCE.md containing: the six BuilderOS Design Principles, the Independent Reasoning Before Consensus principle, the Decision Record schema, the Collaboration Spine pipeline, and the Mission 2 Success Test.
Add AMENDMENT_BUILDEROS_CONVERGENCE.md to docs/constitution/CONSTITUTION_INVENTORY.md (or the canonical amendment registry) so the constitution points to it.
Do not edit NORTH_STAR_SSOT.md directly unless it is read in full first; prefer an amendment file and a reference.

must_prove: AMENDMENT_BUILDEROS_CONVERGENCE.md exists and contains all six design principles verbatim.
AMENDMENT_BUILDEROS_CONVERGENCE.md defines the Decision Record required sections.
The canonical constitution inventory references the amendment.

steps.on_block: Create a DECISION-XXXX.md if there is any constitutional conflict before editing NORTH_STAR_SSOT.md.

steps.title: Record Mission 2 Convergence start in product homes and continuity log
required_edits: Update docs/products/builderos/PRODUCT_HOME.md Last Updated and add a Change Receipts row: date, what changed (new mission pack created), why (founder convergence directive), and the current git SHA.
Append a one-paragraph summary to docs/CONTINUITY_LOG.md with the mission ID, base commit, and open blockers.

must_prove: Last Updated is the current date.
Change Receipts table contains the new mission pack reference.
CONTINUITY_LOG contains a dated entry for FACTORY-BUILDEROS-CONVERGENCE-0001.

steps.title: Create the Decision Record template and the Collaboration Spine artifact schema
required_edits: Create builderos-reboot/DECISIONS/DECISION_RECORD_TEMPLATE.md with the canonical sections: Decision ID, Founder Intent, Alternatives Considered, Per-Role Reasoning (Chair, Architect, Sentry, Wisdom, CFO), Assumptions, Predictions, Success Criteria, Consensus, Why, How Reality Will Judge This, and Reality Judgment (updated after implementation).
Create a sample DECISION-0001.md for the Mission 2 Convergence mission itself, recording the decision to adopt the six design principles and the Collaboration Spine.
Create docs/audits/builderos-mission-2/COLLABORATION_SPINE.md documenting the pipeline: Mission -> Evidence -> Reviewer Comments -> Challenges -> Consensus -> Decision -> Receipt -> Next Mission.

must_prove: DECISION_RECORD_TEMPLATE.md contains all required sections.
DECISION-0001.md exists and is a valid decision record.
COLLABORATION_SPINE.md explains the pipeline and names the canonical artifact locations.

steps.title: Implement decision-record verifier
required_edits: scripts/verify-decision-record.mjs must accept a path, read a decision record .md, and validate that all required sections are present and non-empty.
Exit 0 with JSON { ok: true, missing: [] } if valid; exit 1 with JSON { ok: false, missing: [...] } if invalid.
tests/verify-decision-record.test.js must cover: a valid record, a record missing the Consensus section, and a record with empty Why section.

must_prove: node scripts/verify-decision-record.mjs builderos-reboot/MISSIONS/FACTORY-BUILDEROS-CONVERGENCE-0001/DECISION-0001.md exits 0.
node --test tests/verify-decision-record.test.js exits 0.

steps.title: Implement the Collaboration Spine assembler
required_edits: scripts/collaboration-spine-assemble.mjs takes a JSON input { mission, evidence[], reviewer_comments[], challenges[], consensus, decision, receipt, next_mission } and writes a DECISION-XXXX.md file using DECISION_RECORD_TEMPLATE.md.
Run it once to produce builderos-reboot/DECISIONS/CONVERGENCE-0001.md as the canonical decision record for this mission.

must_prove: node scripts/collaboration-spine-assemble.mjs with a test fixture produces a valid DECISION-XXXX.md that passes scripts/verify-decision-record.mjs.
CONVERGENCE-0001.md is created and valid.

steps.title: Create the blueprint-authority gate library
required_edits: scripts/lib/blueprint-authority-gate.mjs exposes evaluateBlueprintAuthority({ changedFiles, bpPriorityJson, decisionsDir, gapFillLedgerPath, logger }).

For each changed file in services/, routes/, middleware/, or factory-core/, the gate must determine whether the change is authorized by one of: (a) the active BP_PRIORITY mission blueprint, (b) an approved DECISION-XXXX.md whose target_files includes the path, (c) a GAP_FILL_LEDGER.json entry with a HAND-AUTHORED-JUSTIFICATION that covers the file and is under the line-count threshold, or (d) a HIST-owned file (e.g., legacy boot-domains paths) marked with _authority.hist in the file or product home.
Return { ok: true } if authorized; { ok: false, unauthorized: [...], warnings: [...] } if not. Do not throw.

must_prove: A changed route file listed in the active mission blueprint returns ok: true.
A changed service file with no matching blueprint, decision, or GAP-FILL returns ok: false with the path in unauthorized.
A changed file covered by a valid GAP-FILL entry returns ok: true.
node --test tests/blueprint-authority-gate.test.js exits 0.

steps.title: Wire blueprint-authority gate into the commit path as detect-and-route
required_edits: Inside commitOrMirrorFiles, after the existing security-invariants check and the new ai-security-review call, call evaluateBlueprintAuthority({ changedFiles: fileEntries.map(e => e.path), bpPriorityJson, decisionsDir: 'builderos-reboot/DECISIONS', gapFillLedgerPath: 'docs/products/builderos/GAP_FILL_LEDGER.json', logger: log }).

If unauthorized files are found, log a warning with the list and add a governance_warning to the response. Do NOT block the commit on this gate for Mission 2; promotion to BLOCK requires a true/false-positive track record.
Record the gate result in the capability ledger / model capability table.

must_prove: A commit with only blueprint-authorized files produces no blueprint-authority warnings.
A commit with an unauthorized service file produces a governance_warning but the commit still succeeds.
node --check routes/lifeos-council-builder-routes.js passes.

steps.title: Wire blueprint-authority gate into the preflight path
required_edits: Add a non-blocking blueprint-authority check to builder:preflight that runs scripts/lib/blueprint-authority-gate.mjs against the working tree and prints unauthorized files as warnings.
The preflight must still exit 0 for warnings; only exit 1 if the gate itself crashes or an existing check fails.

must_prove: npm run builder:preflight still exits 0 on the current repo state.
If a test service file is added without authority, the preflight output contains a clear warning naming the file and the required authority (BP, DECISION, or GAP-FILL).

steps.title: Finalize the scheduler audit and ensure it is consistent with runtime
required_edits: Verify every start*/register* scheduler call in server-founder-runtime.js and startup/boot-domains.js is listed.
Ensure each row has Classification (founder_runtime / env_gated / full_runtime_only), Prerequisite/Env Gate, Recommendation, and Evidence.
Mark startBpPriorityScheduler as env_gated but not wired into founder runtime; flag this as a known gap unless P3 rewire is approved.

must_prove: SCHEDULER_AUDIT.md contains at least one row for each unique scheduler start function in server-founder-runtime.js and boot-domains.js.
A programmatic check (e.g., a grep-based test) confirms the audit covers all start* functions.

steps.title: Expose scheduler armed/disarmed status in the builder control-plane
required_edits: Add a GET /api/v1/lifeos/builder/control-plane/schedulers endpoint (or extend /ready) that returns a JSON object of env-gated schedulers: { neverStopProductFactory: { armed: <bool>, env: 'BUILDEROS_NEVER_STOP' }, governedAutonomousShip: { armed: <bool>, env: 'GOVERNED_AUTONOMOUS_SHIP' }, memoryEmbeddingsBackfill: { armed: <bool>, env: 'OPENAI_API_KEY' }, bpPriority: { armed: <bool>, env: 'BUILDEROS_AUTOPILOT' } }.
'armed' means the env var is set and non-placeholder and the scheduler is registered in server-founder-runtime.js.
Add a test verifying the endpoint returns the expected shape and that missing keys report armed: false.

must_prove: GET /api/v1/lifeos/builder/control-plane/schedulers returns 200 with the scheduler armed object.
node --test tests/builderos-control-plane-schedulers.test.js exits 0.

steps.title: Rewire BP priority scheduler into founder runtime if approved
required_edits: If the Decision Record for this step approves, import and call startBpPriorityScheduler in server-founder-runtime.js in the same try/catch pattern as startNeverStopProductFactoryScheduler.
Ensure it is gated by BUILDEROS_AUTOPILOT (or equivalent) and reports armed/disarmed in the new control-plane endpoint.
If not approved, update SCHEDULER_AUDIT.md with the explicit decision that BP priority scheduler remains full_runtime_only and why.

must_prove: After approval, server-founder-runtime.js calls startBpPriorityScheduler and the scheduler status endpoint reflects it.
node --check server-founder-runtime.js passes.

steps.title: Configure and verify a real email provider for SMOS
required_edits: Founder action: set EMAIL_PROVIDER and the corresponding key (e.g., RESEND_API_KEY for Resend, or SMTP_* for SMTP) plus EMAIL_FROM in Railway via POST /api/v1/railway/env/bulk or the Railway dashboard.
After the key is set, send a test email from the production container using core/notification-service.js and confirm delivery to a real inbox.
Update services/env-registry-map.js to mark the chosen provider key as SET and the others as not needed.
Update products/receipts/SMOS_REAL_CUSTOMER_READINESS.json with email_provider_verified: true, the provider name, the verified sending domain, and the test email timestamp.

must_prove: A real test email is delivered from the production container.
SMOS_REAL_CUSTOMER_READINESS.json reflects the verified provider.

steps.on_block: Record exact missing env vars and provider setup steps in the open-questions section of the handoff.

steps.title: Complete one real SMOS $49 charge end-to-end
required_edits: Founder action: use a real debit/credit card to complete the Stripe Checkout session created by POST /api/v1/marketing/pack/checkout.
After payment, call GET /api/v1/marketing/sessions/:id/export and confirm it returns the paid content pack (not 402 payment_required).
Confirm the marketing_pack_checkouts row for the session has status paid and the Stripe payment_intent is captured.
Update products/receipts/SMOS_REAL_CUSTOMER_READINESS.json with live_charge_completed: true, charge_id, and timestamp.

must_prove: A real $49 charge succeeds in Stripe live mode.
GET /api/v1/marketing/sessions/:id/export returns the content pack after payment.
SMOS_REAL_CUSTOMER_READINESS.json reflects live_charge_completed: true.

steps.on_block: Record the exact blocker (card, Stripe live mode, export entitlement bug) in the open-questions section.

steps.title: Run SENTRY Layer A + B for the SMOS revenue loop
required_edits: Run node scripts/sentry-prealpha-gate.mjs marketingos (Layer A) and confirm 0 findings.
Run the Layer B browser walkthrough: /marketing -> signup -> create session -> coach -> export -> payment prompt -> complete payment -> content delivered. Screenshot each step.
If findings exist, each must carry a proposed_solution before the mission claims the revenue loop closed.

must_prove: Layer A receipts pass 0 findings.
Layer B walkthrough screenshots and UX critique are recorded in products/receipts/SENTRY_MARKETINGOS_LAYER_B.json.
No Layer B finding lacks a proposed_solution.

steps.title: Implement decision-aware wisdom drift check
required_edits: scripts/wisdom-decision-drift.mjs reads all builderos-reboot/DECISIONS/DECISION-*.md files, extracts the Predictions and Success Criteria sections, and compares them to the corresponding OBJECTIVE_VERDICT.json or products/receipts/* ACCEPTANCE receipt.
For each decision, produce a DECISION_DRIFT_<id>.json receipt with { decision_id, prediction_status, assumptions_proved_true[], assumptions_proved_false[], recommendations_for_future_blueprints[] }.
If reality contradicts a prediction, the script writes a governance warning and proposes a blueprint update.
tests/wisdom-decision-drift.test.js uses a fixture decision and receipt to verify the comparison logic.

must_prove: node scripts/wisdom-decision-drift.mjs runs against the sample DECISION-0001.md and produces products/receipts/DECISION_DRIFT_CONVERGENCE.json.
node --test tests/wisdom-decision-drift.test.js exits 0.

steps.title: Produce final Mission 2 Convergence handoff artifact
required_edits: Create docs/audits/builderos-mission-2/MISSION_2_CONVERGENCE_HANDOFF.md with: Package Status table, What Was True at Base Commit, Decisions Made, Unresolved Questions, Authority State, How the Next Agent Should Continue, Verification Commands, and Mission 3 Prep (what is now easier).
Create scripts/verify-mission-2-convergence-handoff.mjs that checks the handoff base commit against origin/main and required sections.

Create OBJECTIVE_VERDICT.json with the final verdict and metrics: number of founder interventions required, number of manual agent handoffs eliminated, time to verified implementation, preflight pass/fail counts, and a Mission 3 scoping note.

must_prove: HANDOFF.md contains all required sections.
verify-mission-2-convergence-handoff.mjs runs and exits 0 when origin/main matches the base commit.
OBJECTIVE_VERDICT.json contains quantitative Mission 2 success metrics and a Mission 3 prep note.

steps.title: Register the completed mission in BP_PRIORITY and prepare Mission 3 note
required_edits: Add FACTORY-BUILDEROS-CONVERGENCE-0001 to builderos-reboot/BP_PRIORITY.json as a completed item with receipt_verdict PASS, technical_pass_at, git_sha, and production_base.
Update docs/products/builderos/PRODUCT_HOME.md Change Receipts with the mission completion summary and the acceptance command used.
Append to docs/CONTINUITY_LOG.md the final one-paragraph summary and the Mission 3 scoping note.

must_prove: BP_PRIORITY.json contains the new item with correct product_id, blueprint_path, receipt_path, and PASS verdict.
npm run lifeos:bp-priority:verify exits 0.
